content.short: SeedClub is a DAO that builds and invests in communities.
content.description: SeedClub supports web3 community builders with a vision of a future where the value created by online communities belongs to the people who build them, not the platforms that host them. It advances this goal through an accelerator program, studio projects, and a growing network of contributors, collaborators, and members who contribute to and benefit from shared initiatives. SeedClub's strength comes from its portfolio of projects and an expanding DAO ecosystem of builders.
